title: Ember Tabata
description: Driving tabata with tuck jumps, pop squats, lateral bounds and Russian twists to torch calories

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Tuck jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump bringing knees up to the chest

exercises.name: Pop squats
exercises.instructions: Jump feet wide into a squat, jump feet together

exercises.name: Lateral bounds
exercises.instructions: Powerful lateral jumps from foot to foot

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet off the floor, rotate the torso side to side

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
